concept: The gold thread: one gold line runs through the reel and becomes every element: the hook's underline, the edge that opens the method page, the rule under 200+, the signature under the logo.
system: Cormorant Garamond 500/600 + italic (headlines, the accent word in gold) and Montserrat 600/700/800 (labels, the pillars' verbs, UI). Gold #F6D43A (dark gold #98831A on paper), black #070707, paper #F4F2EC. Headlines 104-204px, labels 30px tracked 0.32em, counter 330px. Margins 90px. Entrances 0.45-0.8s expo-out on beats (120 BPM, bars every 2 s, the drop at 2.0 s); exits 0.25s ease-in; depth from perspective 1700-1800px.
